item.title: [No Priors] Re-Founding Incumbents for the AI Era with Sequence Holdings Co-Founder and CEO Michael Lee
item.description: Speaker 1 | 00:00 - 00:25 Every company on the planet has a celebrated persona. In a world where you believe that alpha comes from engineering and AI, you need to create a culture whereby the celebrated persona is the engineer, and that's what's required.
